sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: DMRs is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Designated Marksman Rifle handling skill improves the overall handling, reduces recoil and reload time of DMRs.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases reload speed (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Increases weapon switching speed (0.8% per level → +40% at Elite Level)
- Reduces weapon recoil (0.3% per level → -15% at Elite Level)
- Improves weapon ergonomics (0.2% per level → +10% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Steady aim for the first 3 seconds with any stamina condition
- Elite level: Doubles mastering gain

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Landing hits on enemies with Designated marksman rifles
- Reloading Designated marksman rifles
- Cycling the action/Unloading the chambers of Designated marksman rifles
- Completing the quest The Cleaner
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize
